profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary: I am a dedicated and motivated software engineer with over 4 years of experience designing, developing, and delivering custom web applications and software solutions. My proven track record of leveraging full-stack development and front-end/back-end technologies to create user-responsive apps in a React and Angular. I am an out-of-the-box thinker able to work with diverse clients and colleagues to deliver results on time and under budget. My qualifications include a Bachelor of Arts in Applied Mathematics from the University of California, Berkeley.

positions.title: Web Designer & SEO Analyst
positions.description: As an SEO Manager in the automotive industry, I worked with multiple clients to improve search engine rankings by eliminating broken links and other problematic content. I also integrated Google Analytics, Search Console, and Google My Business to manage SEO and conducted SEO audits using tools like Screaming Frog. Additionally, I analyzed rankings, local maps, and competitive keywords with SEMrush to propel companies to top search engine results positions, and provided recommendations for content development to boost click rates.

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description: Implemented agile project management and software development processes by facilitating sprint planning meetings and ensuring new features were efficiently reviewed and incorporated into our project management tool. Achieved 90% code coverage for unit and acceptance tests, and significantly reduced continuous integration testing time by 80%. Developed a rewards and accomplishments system within the application to improve user retention. Java Python MySQL C++ Cascading Style Sheets (CSS), Programming, Git, Linux, Web Development, PHP, HTML5, jQuery

honors.title: Posse Scholar (Full-tuition scholarship)
honors.description: One of the primary aims of The Posse Foundation is to train the leaders of tomorrow. The Career Program provides Posse Scholars with the tools and opportunities needed to secure the most competitive and career-enhancing internships and leadership-track jobs in a variety of industries. In order to achieve this, Posse partners with exceptional companies and organizations worldwide and establishes affiliations with top graduate and professional schools. The Career Program has five core components: 1) Internships, 2) Career Development Workshops, 3) Career Coaching, 4) Graduate + Fellowship Programs, and 5) The Alumni Network.

honors.title: UC Berkeley CS Dept. Evernote Hackathon (Awarded Best Design)
honors.description:
● Engaged in a team of four to assemble a web app using the Evernote API.
● Built a web app to sync users' typing with lectures with time stamps, cutting down the average time of referencing a webcast.
● Awarded best designed app and received a personal tour of the Evernote Campus in Redwood, CA
